tools.name: hyphae_native_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect bounded Native product capabilities through the authenticated v2 authority.

tools.name: hyphae_native_security_status
tools.description: Read redacted Native access-control status using the API key's exact authority.

tools.name: hyphae_native_security_principals
tools.description: List one bounded redacted Native principal page using an opaque authorization-bound cursor.

tools.name: hyphae_native_search_lexical
tools.description: Execute one bounded lexical query (term, phrase, prefix, or fuzzy) against a Native physical index through the authenticated v2 authority.

tools.name: hyphae_native_search_collection
tools.description: Execute one integrated lexical, named-vector, or hybrid search over a Native search collection with typed filters, sorts, facets, and aggregations, reporting the per-branch strategy and recall-risk evidence.

filter.description: Typed doc-value filter: match_all; exists {field}; compare {field, operator: equal|not_equal|less|less_or_equal|greater|greater_or_equal, value}; all/any {filters: [...]}; not {filter}; in {field, values: [...]}; is_null {field}; like {field, pattern with _ and % wildcards}. Unknown keys for the declared operation fail closed.

fusion.description: Branch-combination method. Absent means deterministic weighted reciprocal-rank fusion; weighted_score blends branch weights with normalized branch scores.

parent_dedupe.description: First-k-per-parent deduplication over the final ranking; hits missing the field are never deduplicated.

tools.name: hyphae_native_prove_search
tools.description: Generate one sealed offline-verifiable proof and complete directory witness for an integrated search, returned hex-encoded within the bounded message budget.

filter.description: Typed doc-value filter: match_all; exists {field}; compare {field, operator: equal|not_equal|less|less_or_equal|greater|greater_or_equal, value}; all/any {filters: [...]}; not {filter}; in {field, values: [...]}; is_null {field}; like {field, pattern with _ and % wildcards}. Unknown keys for the declared operation fail closed.

fusion.description: Branch-combination method. Absent means deterministic weighted reciprocal-rank fusion; weighted_score blends branch weights with normalized branch scores.

parent_dedupe.description: First-k-per-parent deduplication over the final ranking; hits missing the field are never deduplicated.

tools.name: hyphae_native_verify_proof
tools.description: Verify one sealed proof and complete witness against an external trusted anchor entirely inside the adapter process; verification is trustless and never contacts the service.

tools.name: hyphae_native_search_ingest
tools.description: Atomically ingest one bounded idempotent document batch into a Native search collection. Listed and callable only when the adapter was started with --allow-ingest and the key carries write authority.

tools.name: hyphae_native_memory_store
tools.description: Store one bounded memory: the text ingests under its content-derived identity and a scalar lifecycle key carries the text and optional TTL. Recallable exactly while the key lives. Listed and callable only with --allow-ingest and write authority.

tools.name: hyphae_native_memory_recall
tools.description: Recall memories by bounded lexical retrieval, keeping only hits whose lifecycle key still lives — expired or forgotten memories never return. With prove, the sealed proof, witness, and anchor ride the response for offline verification.

tools.name: hyphae_native_memory_forget
tools.description: Forget one memory permanently: the lifecycle key tombstones and the document leaves every branch, so recall can never surface it again. Listed and callable only with --allow-ingest and write authority.
